cheap.notes: Keep simple repetitive work local and escalate only when quality or write access demands it.

balanced.notes: Use specialized planners, builders, and reviewers with a fast fallback path.

premium.notes: Use higher-quality remote lanes first when the task is risky or strategic.

quick_ping_strategy: Prefer local config, auth, or cached state before heavy CLI status calls.
Hide console windows and keep probes short.
deep_ping_strategy: Send a compact deterministic request that proves a real roundtrip.
Capture framework label, target model or agent, and visible assistant text.
